model: Canonical adapter outbound message identity is domain-separated by adapter ID and local chain ID, monotonically sequenced by an adapter-local nonce, and reachable only through the configured GatewayRouter boundary. Failed or unauthorized attempts must not consume nonce or replay state.
invariants: Ethereum and Solana adapter domains are distinct and nonzero
outbound source message identity binds adapter ID and local block chain ID
identical economic outbound requests across Ethereum and Solana cannot share a source message ID
successful outbound requests advance the adapter-local nonce exactly once
sequential identical outbound requests produce distinct source message IDs
failed outbound validation does not advance nonce
unauthorized direct outbound calls cannot bypass the configured router and do not advance nonce
unauthorized direct inbound calls cannot bypass the configured router and do not consume replay state
router authorization is immutable after adapter construction
router-bypass rejection occurs before verifier, replay or nonce state mutation
qualification_tests: cross-adapter identical economic outbound requests derive distinct source message IDs
sequential Ethereum outbound requests advance nonce exactly once and produce distinct IDs
sequential Solana outbound requests advance nonce exactly once and produce distinct IDs
direct unauthorized Ethereum inbound and outbound calls fail closed
direct unauthorized Solana inbound and outbound calls fail closed
router-bypass attempts preserve replay and nonce state
follow_on: V12.6.7 governance, accounting, registry and recovery hardening
